name: threadline
description: Portable agent environment manager for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Kimi, RAG, Obsidian handoffs, and project-aware workflows.

scripts.check: node --check bin/threadline && node --check src/cli.mjs && node --check src/core/detect-project.mjs && node --check src/core/paths.mjs && node --check src/core/plan.mjs
scripts.smoke: node bin/threadline detect --path examples/fullstack-js --json && node bin/threadline setup --dry-run --runtimes claude,codex && node bin/threadline init --path examples/fullstack-js --dry-run
